Phone controller

Connecting…

Waits at least 400 ms and requires 250 ms of low rotation after a stroke. Very fast consecutive strokes may be skipped.

Phone-angle aiming

After gyro calibration, hold the phone in portrait in your ready grip and set neutral aim. Tilt sideways: ±65° gives full aim; a 3° dead zone keeps center steady. Forward/back tilt sets depth (±45°): positive means deeper, negative means shorter. A small random spread varies each aimed shot. Faster swings add speed and depth and can land long; players stop chasing predicted out shots.
